talentInfo.title: Power Hungry
talentInfo.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shackler
talentInfo.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Target Practice
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

talentInfo.title: Locust Brood
talentInfo.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

talentInfo.title: Ravaging Ferocity
talentInfo.description: Ravage grants Kerrigan 25% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Heavy Burden
talentInfo.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Jailors
talentInfo.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.  Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.  Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

talentInfo.title: Slapathur
talentInfo.description: Abathur's Basic Attacks deal 350% additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds.  The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Wall Of Bones
talentInfo.description: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

talentInfo.title: Healmonger
talentInfo.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 210 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Intimidation
talentInfo.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Skeletal Mages
talentInfo.description: Vector Targeting Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Poly Bomb
talentInfo.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: That's the Stuff!
talentInfo.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

talentInfo.title: Echoes of Death
talentInfo.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

talentInfo.title: Fission Bomb
talentInfo.description: Increases Living Bomb's explosion radius by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Enough to Share
talentInfo.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 190 (+4% per level) damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 (+4% per level) damage, up to 420 (+4% per level).

talentInfo.title: Weaken
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Hush!
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

talentInfo.title: Diamond Skin
talentInfo.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Demoralizing Shout
talentInfo.description: Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.  Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

talentInfo.title: Iceblade Arrows
talentInfo.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

talentInfo.title: Dusk Wing
talentInfo.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

talentInfo.title: Temporal Flux
talentInfo.description: Disintegrate gradually Slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

talentInfo.title: Mortal Wound
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Burn The Impure
level_one.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level_four.title: Battle Hunger
level_four.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level_seven.title: Flash of Anger
level_seven.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Angelic Armaments
level_ten.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

level_thirteen.title: Pathetic Mortals
level_thirteen.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Swiftness
level_sixteen.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

level_twenty.title: Brand of Solarion
level_twenty.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level_twenty.title: Radiating Faith
level_twenty.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

level_one.title: Burn The Impure
level_one.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level_four.title: Battle Hunger
level_four.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level_seven.title: Holy Fervor
level_seven.description: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

level_ten.title: Angelic Armaments
level_ten.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

level_thirteen.title: Divine Rage
level_thirteen.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Melting Touch
level_sixteen.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Heavenly Host
level_twenty.description: Shields granted by Angelic Armaments no longer expire, and on initial activation, nearby allied Heroes gain a Shield that absorbs 600 (+4% per level) damage.  If a Shield granted to an allied Hero lasts 3 seconds, it fires 1 sword at a nearby enemy, prioritizing closest Heroes, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage.

level_one.title: Enhanced Agility
level_one.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level_four.title: One-Who-Collects
level_four.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_seven.title: Feeding Frenzy
level_seven.description: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.  Gambit: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Every death reduces this cooldown reduction by 0.25 seconds, up to 3 times.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ferocious Stalker
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 50% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level_sixteen.title: Tunneling Claws
level_sixteen.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

level_twenty.title: Contagion
level_twenty.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target, but it deals 60% less damage to all targets.

level_one.title: Extra-Wound Timers
level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Taste For Explosions
level_four.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

level_seven.title: Bogged Down
level_seven.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

level_ten.title: RIP-Tire
level_ten.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

level_thirteen.title: Ripper Air
level_thirteen.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

level_sixteen.title: Endless Nades
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cannonball!
level_twenty.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level_one.title: Patchwork Creation
level_one.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.  Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

level_four.title: Playtime!
level_four.description: Basic Attacks restore 5 Mana and reduce Slam's cooldown by 0.75 seconds.  For each enemy Hero hit by Slam's inner area, restore 5 Mana and reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Serrated Edge
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

level_ten.title: Gorge
level_ten.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

level_thirteen.title: Meat Hook
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

level_sixteen.title: Pulverize
level_sixteen.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Master Hooker
level_twenty.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Searing Light
level_one.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

level_four.title: Repeated Offense
level_four.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.  Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Piercing Lash
level_thirteen.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level_twenty.title: Shield of Hope
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.
